components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:

        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number

            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is

          maxLength: 20

        email:

## Summary

I changed telephone handling so numbers are stored and returned in **E.164 form**, matching the spec.

**New shared logic** — `TelephoneNormalizer` (`rest/validation/`):
- Strips all non-digit separators (spaces, dashes, brackets, etc.).
- A leading `+` keeps the supplied country code; otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits.
- Requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, else the number is unformattable → `null`.
- `'0412 345 678'` → `'+61412345678'`, `'+64 21 123 456'` → `'+6421123456'`.

**Wired into the existing layers:**
- **`TelephoneValidator`** now delegates to `TelephoneNormalizer.isValid`, so an unformattable raw value (e.g. `'12'`) is rejected with **400** at request validation. Updated the `@TelephoneValidation` message/Javadoc accordingly.
- **`OwnerMapper.normalizeTelephone`** now produces the E.164 string on create instead of a bare 10-digit number.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.updateOwner`** now normalizes to E.164 too (previously it stored the raw DTO value).
- **`Owner` entity** persistence constraint changed from `^[0-9]{10}$` (+ `@Digits`) to `^\+[0-9]{8,15}$` so the stored E.164 value validates on save.
- **Duplicate detection** is unchanged in mechanism (`existsByTelephone` exact-match) but now compares E.164 values, because the value passed in and stored is E.164.
- Updated the `openapi.yml` telephone description/example to document the new normalization.

Duplicate detection now compares E.164 values as required. Existing seed rows (raw `608555xxxx`) are inserted via SQL and never re-validated, so they're untouched and simply won't collide with any E.164 lookup.
